items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: And we had another fellow who was playing the trombone, but he was playing a vowel trombone, his name was Charlie, we called him Big Charlie

ctx.x: Maybe. Well he was no big man, but he could read pretty much. And we had another fellow who was playing the trombone, but he was playing a vowel trombone, his name was Charlie, we called him Big Charlie, big tall man, we had about, oh man, he was about seven foot tall, eight foot tall. And he had that little bit of trombone, the vowel trombone with the keys, you know, playing like that. And that's the first job I played, so we made, I think it was two dollars.
And how old were you about?
